answers.core: Part of RPCs, impossible to mod RPCs.
answers.workaround:
Easily, with the Singleton pattern. So it's not major. I would suggest focusing on so many other issues instead of this.

This prevents using static functions because you never know when some static function will be invoked by an RPC, so its safer to just go Singleton from the start, and anything would-be static, becomes part of a Singleton. A minor inconvenience, really.

title: Allow static functions to be invoked by RPCs
